description: Catalog of agent harnesses — coding-agent runtimes, harness toolkits, and orchestration frameworks used across the FlexNetOS meta workspace.

harnesses.summary: A standalone coding agent with the IDE wired in — a TypeScript/Rust/Bun monorepo (omp) with its own TUI, swarm-extension, and agent/ai packages. Not a Claude Code plugin; a coding-agent harness of its own.
The harness toolkit/landing vendored in this repo at harness/ (skills, docs, site). Source of the `harness` meta-skill that defines specialized agents and the skills they use.
harnesses.notes: Vendored in-repo at harness/ (nested .git stripped). Not a nested-meta child; lives directly in harness_hub's tree.

harnesses.summary: First packaged harness shipped by the harness plugin. An autonomous, resumable, self-restarting Ralph loop (/harness:meta-plugin) that organizes the FlexNetOS meta workspace via harness_hub/meta-plugins/meta_plugin_protocol/meta_plugin_api: hub/registry consistency, cross-repo build/test/lint health, protocol↔consumer drift, and catalog/inventory organization. Run in place or eject into a target repo's .claude/.
harnesses.notes: Packaged harness inside the harness plugin (harness/skills/meta-plugin + shared agents in harness/agents/). Invoke /harness:meta-plugin; ejectable via skills/meta-plugin/scripts/eject.sh. Pilot for the packaged-harness convention (docs/packaged-harness-standard.md).

harnesses.summary: FlexNetOS handoff/continuity kernel — the hf binary + .handoff/ witnessed ledger. The only sanctioned cross-session continuity path: checkpoint/handoff packets are rendered from the ledger, never hand-written. Ships the handoff-discipline harness (skills + agents) and fleet coordination.

Rust-native agent-to-agent session mesh with a native tmux/zellij injector — concurrent coding-agent sessions message each other and push into a running terminal pane (degrades to hook-delivery-on-next-turn with no multiplexer). One static binary; ships an MCP server (weave_send/ask/inbox/…). The workspace's real-time messaging substrate; complements the handoff continuity kernel.

Packaged harness (/harness:rust-port): an autonomous, resumable Ralph loop that performs a full-feature, NO-DOWNGRADE port of a source project (TypeScript/Python/...) to idiomatic Rust — and optionally MERGES each verified unit into a destination repo Y (re-verified in Y; the rust-port->rust-port-merge arc). A parity ledger + per-symbol map inventory every source unit/symbol; each is ported fully (no stubs), differentially parity-verified, then (if merging) integrated into Y and re-verified. Automated 3-model workflow (opus gates / sonnet workers / haiku mechanical). DONE only at 100% port (+100% merge when set) with left-behind sweeps — no feature logic left behind.
harnesses.notes: Packaged harness in the harness plugin (harness/skills/rust-port + rust-port-{inventory,translate,parity,merge}/cross-repo-reference + shared icm-memory/session-relay-*/cross-repo-health/harness-loop-init/harness-evolution; 10 agents = 7 specialists incl. merge-integrator/researcher/cross-repo-referencer + 3 shared). Agents have icm-memory to recall/store durable memory as needed (runtime-delegated, graceful no-op without ICM). Invoke /harness:rust-port; ejectable via skills/rust-port/scripts/eject.sh. DONE gate covers per-symbol parity + runtime-construct + (when merging) merge-ledger re-verified in dest repo Y. Automated 3-model workflow (opus gates / sonnet / haiku). Flagship: TS->Rust port of meta/Archon merged into harness-agent-rs.

harnesses.summary: Packaged harness (/harness:code-research): an autonomous, resumable, READ-ONLY loop that deeply researches and analyzes a codebase to answer a question with cited, adversarially-verified evidence. Maps the code + decomposes the question into dimensions; fan-out analysts produce file:line-cited claims; an adversarial verifier tries to REFUTE each claim against the source (running it where ambiguous); a synthesizer writes a decision-grade report (verdict-first, confidence-rated, gaps named). Conclusions are earned by evidence that survived refutation — not plausible guesses.
harnesses.notes: Packaged harness in the harness plugin (harness/skills/code-research + code-research-* sub-skills + shared agents). Invoke /harness:code-research; ejectable. Read-only: maps a codebase, fan-out analysts produce cited claims, adversarial verifier refutes claims vs code, synthesizer writes a decision-grade report.

harnesses.summary: The envctl-proven construction crew — feature-forge-architect→feature-forge-implementer→feature-forge-guardian — that turns a feature/upgrade request into invariant-verified working Rust; runs continuously as the forge-loop Ralph loop over a backlog with tick-on-merged, batch-cadence wrap-up, Phase-3.5 runtime-verify, a symbol-grain Unit-ledger completeness gate, and A2 cross-repo all-green-barrier parallelism; resumable via session-relay; self-evolving via Phase E. Hand-authored in envctl 2026-06-04 and the source pattern this hub abstracted; ejectable into any Rust repo.

Packaged harness (/harness:planning-engineer single cycle · /harness:plan-loop continuous): an autonomous, resumable, READ-ONLY Ralph loop that turns a planning target (crate/subsystem/feature-area) into a decision-grade plan. Background fan-out: a plan-cartographer builds a persistent CODE GRAPH from git-kb code JSON (symbols + call edges + data-flows) with derived graph intelligence (centrality/hotspots, blast-radius, dead code, cycles, layering, public-API) while a plan-trend-researcher does deep web research over a rolling 90-day window (cited+dated). Analysts produce file:line-cited gaps + upgrades tagged quality/speed/accuracy; an adversarial plan-verifier refutes each claim and feasibility-gates each upgrade against the source + repo invariants; a plan-architect synthesizes a verdict-first plan with ASCII architecture diagrams, a sequenced upgrade roadmap, and a tool-evaluation, promoted to docs/ROADMAP + a draft ADR. Self-evaluates and self-upgrades every cycle (fail-closed).
harnesses.notes: Packaged harness in the harness plugin (harness/skills/planning-engineer + plan-loop + plan-cartography/plan-trend-research/plan-test-strategy/plan-synthesis methods, reusing code-research-verify + shared session-relay-*/harness-loop-init/harness-evolution/icm-memory; 8 agents = 6 specialists plan-{cartographer,trend-researcher,analyst,test-strategist,verifier,architect} + 2 shared continuity-steward/evolution-steward). Hybrid sub-agent mode (background fan-out, file-based ledger under .handoff/loop/plan/), all agents model:opus. Read-only on the target's production code; writes plans/graph under .handoff/loop/plan/ + docs/ROADMAP + draft ADRs only. Testing pillar: an always-on test-coverage dimension (plan-test-strategist maps tests by call-graph reachability + designs the suite) emits a Test Strategy & Coverage plan section + a Feature-Forge test-build handoff (the loop plans tests; Feature Forge builds + runs them — read-only preserved); the harness ships hermetic self-tests (scripts/tests/test-plan-{eject,loop-state,contract}.sh) wired into envctl's harness-scripts + loop-state CI gates. Invoke /harness:planning-engineer (one cycle) or /harness:plan-loop (continuous); ejectable via skills/planning-engineer/scripts/eject.sh; external read-only runner ralph-plan.sh. Hand-authored sibling instance also lives in envctl/.claude (ejected). Code graph built ONLY from git-kb code JSON — no C dep, no graph DB (honors the no-C-in-trust-boundary invariant).

harnesses.summary: One-shot, idempotent bootstrap that takes a FRESH repo (no harness, no hf) onto the hf Continuity Ledger Kernel AND the forge-loop/feature-forge construction-crew harness. Installs hf if absent (builds meta/handoff + symlinks), registers the repo as an hf fleet member (.meta.yaml), runs handoff-loop-init (hf init + ledger-residency guard), ejects the feature-forge harness and reconciles its file-based .handoff/loop/ with the kernel .handoff/, wires CLAUDE.md/.gitignore/settings, seeds the backlog, and verifies (hf status + hf fleet render). Safe by default (dry-run; --apply to execute), fail-closed. The kernel-backed loop picks via hf fleet render <member> (HFTASK-0054-aware) with a file-based cycle counter.
